propositions: A CriteriaError raised during deterministic criteria assembly is wrongly classified as llm_unavailable=true by the generic degraded verdict path, causing a broken installed build to appear as an LLM outage instead of a configuration fault.

The workflow recorder discards typed exception identity and preserves only undifferentiated failure strings, preventing gate dispatch from recognizing criteria config failures distinct from genuine LLM/provider errors.

Plan review must emit a fail-closed INDETERMINATE verdict with a distinct config_fault field and actionable diagnostic naming the installed rebar build as the suspect when criteria assembly fails, without the llm_unavailable flag.
Deterministic coverage findings and existing blocker behavior must be preserved in the config-fault verdict path; genuine LLM unavailability cases must remain unchanged.
